mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, issued_at, replaced_at, version FROM iam_recovery_code_set WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND replaced_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_recovery_code_set (id, account_id, issued_at, version) VALUES (#{set.id}, #{set.accountId}, #{set.issuedAt}, #{set.version})

INSERT INTO iam_recovery_code (id, set_id, code_hash, created_at) VALUES
(#{code.id}, #{code.setId}, #{code.codeHash}, #{code.createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT code.id AS code_id, code.set_id, code_set.account_id, code.code_hash, code_set.version AS set_version FROM iam_recovery_code_set code_set JOIN iam_recovery_code code ON code.set_id = code_set.id WHERE code_set.account_id = #{accountId} AND code_set.replaced_at IS NULL AND code.used_at IS NULL ORDER BY code.id
